playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Make landfall at Newport Harbor; face inland from the working wharf.
playthrough_trace.note: Arrival at Newport Harbor frames the player as a newcomer stepping off the working wharf.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Follow the harborfront road to Edrin Vale at the Counting House.
playthrough_trace.note: The first objective and route hint orient the player toward Edrin at the Counting House.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Ask at the wharf apron, merchant row, or civic notice board about the missing ledger line.
playthrough_trace.note: Edrin gives the missing manifest problem a civic and personal reason to care.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Edrin Vale: The missing line is not a mistake. Ask the wharf who handled the cargo, then listen at the Tavern/Inn.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Take the west connector to Bess Armitage at the Tavern/Inn.
playthrough_trace.note: A dockworker clue makes the mystery physical instead of abstract ledger text.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Mara Pike: That crate was not lost. Someone made it disappear before the tide bell.

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Choose a next lead: Edrin, the wharf lanterns, or the rear service lane.
playthrough_trace.note: The Tavern/Inn turns investigation into a pre-Revolution whisper-network fantasy.
playthrough_trace.response_text: Bess Armitage: Third Toast, then no names. If the lantern burns twice at the wharf, someone chose a side.
reward_log: Reward: Resolve +5 for following the tavern whisper

playthrough_trace.current_objective_text: Return by the central connector and secure a trusted contact before dawn.
playthrough_trace.note: The wharf lantern rumor confirms that working harbor life is tied to the secret.
